PV_comparison.scope: No fracture path, surface purity, component recovery, heat loss, installed machine or novel advantage supplied. Commercial heated knife and brush scraper are credited from actual manufacturer-page exposure.

drying_mass.qualification: Input slurry must first be formed/consolidated with its liquid paid. Source epsilon0.47/density2740/Srem0.25 belong to that limestone/50kPa fitted case. Do not extrapolate its Srem to all materials or pressures.

pressure_budget.warning: Single-charge surrogate excludes breakthrough gas, cycling, preparation, real gas, heat and depressurization. Do not add it to compressor work as an independent paid drive if compressor already supplies displacement.
